name: cGZPersistBinaryReader::vf25
notes: Hooked (not yet run in-game). Slot 25: reads a flag (stream slot 5); with the flag, reads a second flag and a uint32 index (slot 9); the entry is buffer[(count + head - 1) & (capacity - 1)] in the ring at +8; the element comes from entry +0 (second flag set) or +0xc (clear) and is queried with QueryInterface(id, out). Without the first flag, out is set to null and the return is the low byte of out (not defined; not compared). Null element: out null, return is the low byte of the index (compared as truth value). Test uses full scripts only: a failed index read would walk off the 8-entry table in both sides. Mutants killed: index mask (capacity instead of capacity - 1); entry arrays swapped; second flag read through slot 8 instead of 9; null element returns false; bool normalisation changed to v == 1 (also caught by GetBool and GetBoolArray). Ctor and deleting dtor (0x9bf9a0, 0x9bfc20) are not reimplemented; the layout is documented in the header.

name: cGZPersistBinaryReader::ReadRoot (vf3)
notes: Hooked (not yet run in-game). Slot 3: reads a root object and its dependent resources. Root slot 8 gives its persist resource (null: return), whose slot 3 gives the key; the context's 0xad095a01 face gives the group (+0x24; slot 5; -1 is set to the key's group via slot 6 and put back to -1 at the end). A new ring entry (32 bytes: resources, objects, stream, serial record) is pushed; the stream's 0xc56b8f08 face is the delegate (+0x20). The resource manager (global 0x10c9378 slot 5, ids 0x56b906e/0x656b8efc) registers the root's resource unless it is known (slots 11, 9; 10 at the end). Version word (0xffff0000 mask); per dependent: group, instance, [instance high from version 1], type, mapped by the group face slot 4, then looked up (manager slot 3, iid 0x9b11bf70) in the reader's group, the own group, the fallback group 0x1c0532fa. Objects: count, the root, then class ids created through the director framework (iid 0xbb11a53e); each non-null object's slot 3 reads itself. The dead 'Null dependent resource' Sprintf logging is left out (its text is never used; temporary heap only). Differential: 1500 random worlds (old ring entries, short scripts, every context/known/lookup branch): log of every fake call, the reader state each object's read sees, ring words, refcounts, heap balance. Mutants: docs/subsystems/persistence.md, lane NN.

name: cGZPersistBinaryReader::ReadObject (vf24)
notes: Hooked (not yet run in-game). Slot 24: reads a class id (stream slot 9); 0 gives *out = null; else the director framework creates it (slot 3, iid 0x5b0aaa74), the object reads itself (slot 3 with the reader), is queried for the caller's iid (slot 0) and released (slot 2). Returns what the original's eax holds: the out pointer for class id 0, else the release's result. Differential: 600 cases; the original uses a failed create without a null test, so class ids whose creation fails are not generated, and scripts are always full (a failed read leaves the class id uninitialised). Mutants: docs/subsystems/persistence.md, lane NN.
